facts.anchor: Gyor stood at a small table, fervently shoving food and other supplies into any available pockets of the saddlebags.

facts.fact: 数字：弄到两匹备鞍马——客人喜欢她才肯让
facts.anchor: “You were able to get two?” she asked, relief flooding her.

facts.fact: Torgil 告别托付：保护 Gyor 与旅店、照顾 Svaige——最重要的是活着替两人活

facts.fact: 章中转折：有人唤“Andra”——Lucas 竟然现身

facts.fact: 介绍：Lucas=表亲、Gerrick=帮助我们的人；Gerrick 不握手只问“他也跟我们走？”
facts.anchor: “Gerrick, this is Lucas, my cousin. Lucas, this is Gerrick. He’s helping us.”

facts.fact: Lucas 讲 Avernon：爆炸后全镇疯狂、Jasper 残骸被认出——邻里互疑
facts.anchor: they found the remains of that vermin, Jasper, and everyone started panicking.

facts.fact: 数字：他在破旅店躲至少一星期才毫发无损逃出
facts.anchor: I stayed in that shitty inn for at least a week until I figured out a way to escape the town unscathed.

facts.fact: 追兵突至：奉 Vasara 命搜“光女巫继承人”——Gyor 以旧誓拒绝，Bind him
facts.anchor: “We’ve come in search of the light witch’s heir, by order of Vasara.”

facts.anchor: If we continue until nightfall and camp near the mountain pass, we leave ourselves vulnerable to those who dwell within.

facts.fact: 争吵：她两度挥拳被格挡——“手腕早折了”；她喊 Fight back 他拒绝还手
